item.tib: rgyal ba'i bka' 'bum nyams kyi mgur ma mthong ba don ldan
item.coloph: rgyal ba kun 'dus bla med kyi rnal 'byor chen po rin po che rgyal ba 'od zer mtshan mchog gang des/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i nyams mgur lhug par mdzad nas/ spyang tse nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la brgyud/ nam mkha' gtsug phud la brgyud/ drang srong g.yung drung tshul khrims la brgyud/ sprul sku rgyal ba blo gros la brgyud/ rgyal sras tshul khrims dbang rgyal la brgyud/ drang srong g.yung drung bstan 'dzin tshul khrims la brgyud/ rtogs ldan g.yung drung tshul khrims la brgyud/ des rtsa ba'i bla ma rtogs ldan rin chen lhun grub (la brgyud/)dam pa de'i mdun du (nas) bdag gis thob pa'o//
